subject.title: marketplace-crons: eBay rechaza creates por política de título o descripción

question: Should eBay account-limited and policy-block create failures be treated as SKU-level permanent catalog errors, marketplace-level operational incidents, or a split between those two paths?
rationale: The reopened evidence mixes item-policy rejects with seller-account limitation text; choosing the wrong bucket can either keep retrying impossible SKUs or hide an account-level outage.

options.title: Split by failure family
options.body: Classify item-policy and counterfeit rejects as permanent per SKU, but route account-limited signatures to an operational marketplace-level incident path before re-enabling create.

options.title: Treat all as permanent
options.body: Mark the whole reopened signature family permanent per SKU, reducing retry pressure but risking silent masking of seller-account blocks.

options.title: Keep create disabled
options.body: Leave eBay create off until operations confirms the seller-account/policy state and provides current production evidence.

recommendation.title: Split by failure family
recommendation.body: Classify item-policy and counterfeit rejects as permanent per SKU, but route account-limited signatures to an operational marketplace-level incident path before re-enabling create.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn is tied to the current eBay controller state and recent eBay integration work, so this policy choice likely belongs closest to that area.
